context: Evaluates correct implementation of the cn utility from visionarias-client. The function must use clsx for conditional class name processing and tailwind-merge for resolving Tailwind CSS utility conflicts, combining both in a single exported function.

checklist.name: Uses clsx
checklist.description: Passes all inputs through clsx (or compatible logic) to handle conditional expressions, arrays, and falsy values

checklist.name: Uses twMerge
checklist.description: Wraps the clsx result with twMerge (tailwind-merge) to resolve conflicting Tailwind utility classes

checklist.name: Accepts ClassValue spread
checklist.description: Function signature accepts a rest parameter of ClassValue[] (the type from clsx), allowing any number of inputs

checklist.name: Correct conflict resolution
checklist.description: When two Tailwind classes target the same property (e.g., p-4 and p-8), the last class in the argument list wins
